name: Ocran
title: Father of Pagiel from the tribe of Asher
summary: Ocran is a biblical figure known as the father of Pagiel, who was the leader and chief of the tribe of Asher during the wilderness wanderings. He is mentioned in connection with the census and the offerings at the dedication of the tabernacle. His significance lies in his role as the ancestor of one of the tribe's prominent leaders.

keyEvents.title: Pagiel appointed leader of the tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: Ocran's son Pagiel was appointed leader of the tribe of Asher when the Lord spoke to Moses in the wilderness of Sinai.

keyEvents.title: Camp arrangement of the tribe of Asher
keyEvents.description: Pagiel, son of Ocran, led the tribe of Asher in the camp arrangement during the wilderness wanderings, positioned on the north side of the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Pagiel brings offerings at the altar
keyEvents.description: Pagiel, son of Ocran, brought his offerings on the eleventh day at the dedication of the altar in the tabernacle.

keyEvents.title: Leader of Asher's army contingent
keyEvents.description: Pagiel, son of Ocran, led the army contingent of the tribe of Asher when the Israelites broke camp from the wilderness of Sinai.
